newsitem.title: USA: Black Box Corp names Fred Young president.
newsitem.headline: Black Box Corp names Fred Young president.

text.p: Black Box Corp said Thursday that Fred Young has been named president and chief operating officer.
Jeffery Boetticher is stepping down as president but will continue as chairman and chief executive, the company said.
Young has served as senior vice president, chief operating officer and chief financial officer since May 1996 and has been a director of the company since December 1995.
The company said Anna Baird has been promoted to vice president and chief financial officer. Her earlier title with the company was director of finance.
